sloka: तम् नील जीमूत निकाश कल्पम्सुपाण्डुर उरस्कम् उदार वीर्यम् ।ददर्श लंका अधिपतिः पृथिव्याम्जटायुषम् शान्तम् इव अग्नि दावम् ॥३-५१-४५॥
transliteration: tam nīla jīmūta nikāśa kalpamsupāṇḍura uraskam udāra vīryam ।dadarśa laṁkā adhipatiḥ pṛthivyāmjaṭāyuṣam śāntam iva agni dāvam ॥3-51-45॥

translations.english: Lord of Lanka saw that very bold Jatayu of dark blue colour of the cloud, fair chest, fallen on the ground, looking like the forest fire that had been put out.
